title: Memory Bank Active State
description: Validates memory-bank/active.yaml — the tiny current-state file read at the start of every mode and injected into every turn via the before-submit-prompt hook.

current_task_id.description: The single task any non-/van mode may act on. Null only when no task is active (e.g. immediately after /archive).

current_mode.description: The mode that most recently acted. 'idle' means no mode is active — only /van may run next.

next_action.description: One-line, human-readable description of what the next mode should do. Set by the mode that just finished.

next_mode.description: The mode expected to run next. Used by the stop hook to suggest the transition.

notes.description: Optional free-text context the previous mode wants the next mode to see. Keep short — for anything substantive, write to the appropriate artifact.

allOf.description: If current_mode is not idle, a task must be active.
If idle, no next_mode other than van.
